task_objective: Record the manual-review and warning rule IDs behind each durable release verdict, backfill unchanged old-shape records without moving their audit timestamps, and migrate the existing DeckTools verdict.

setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev and recorded the failure at /tmp/decky-plugins-extended-verdict-rationale-pull-error.log; origin has no dev ref, so the clean local dev tip bc7eb2b was used as the required base.
setup.plan_history: The plan was already committed as the dev tip, so feat/verdict-rationale inherited the required plan-first commit instead of creating a duplicate empty commit.
setup.tooling: The repository has no run.sh. XDG_CACHE_HOME was isolated under /tmp because the sandboxed global uv cache was read-only. The live re-audit reused Trivy 0.73.0 and ClamAV 1.4.5 with packaged signature databases staged under /tmp; no host packages were installed.

implementation.rationale_fields: Every newly recorded verdict includes sorted, deduplicated review_rule_ids and warning_rule_ids lists. They contain only non-allowlisted rule IDs for MANUAL_REVIEW and PASS_WITH_WARNINGS findings; blocking_rule_ids behavior is unchanged.
implementation.public_data_boundary: The tracked store receives rule IDs only. Finding evidence and evidence hashes are never copied into verdict records.
implementation.backfill: When classification, blocking_rule_ids and artifact_sha256 are unchanged, _record_verdict refreshes audit_context_hash and the two rationale fields only when they differ or are missing. The existing audited_at value is preserved. Correct unchanged records still perform no write and remain byte-identical.
implementation.intentional_asymmetry: A MANUAL_REVIEW record can correctly have an empty blocking_rule_ids list; the populated review_rule_ids list explains that verdict without changing catalog-gate behavior.

decktools_re_audit.timestamp_preservation: The verdict retained audited_at 2026-08-03T23:59:40.088915Z while gaining the rationale fields and current audit context hash 49b4281cedd919a3e923d8fb2eead7fd.
decktools_re_audit.reproducibility: A second fresh audit produced the same MANUAL_REVIEW result and left security-verdicts.json byte-identical at sha256 37cd4778c9354999eb48d51472fd1b6965059a86b962c56ddd4f7e12a4e6079f.

verification_evidence.tdd_red: 4 failed and 8 passed before implementation: rationale fields were absent and old or stale records were not backfilled.
verification_evidence.safety_control: 1 passed; the serialized verdict excluded the known evidence value, every overlapping four-character substring, and its sha256.
verification_evidence.mutation_control: Removing review_rule_ids and warning_rule_ids from the unchanged-record refresh branch made the old-shape backfill control fail while determinism and changed-verdict timestamp controls passed: 1 failed, 2 passed. Restoring the branch returned all 3 to passing.
verification_evidence.unchanged_shipping_controls: 35 passed across audit-verdicts, catalog-gate, verdict-publication and audit-cache-invalidation tests.
verification_evidence.migration_assertion: The committed DeckTools record exactly matches the six sorted review rules and three sorted warning rules from the fresh report, retains an empty blocking_rule_ids list and preserves its prior audited_at value.
verification_evidence.quality_gates_pre_session_log: ruff check passed; 34 files already formatted; 242 passed and 21 subtests passed; no deleted review notes.

test_adjustment_rationale: Five new tests were added for the planned behavior and safety boundary. No existing expected value was changed or weakened.
not_verified: No classification, catalog output or gate behavior was intentionally changed; the unchanged targeted suites and full regression suite cover that boundary.
Rule IDs remain identifiers rather than human-readable prose explanations; mapping them to descriptions is outside this plan.
Only the existing DeckTools verdict was migrated, as required.
